posts.author: Krisstopheles
posts.body:
Hey all,
I'm currently working on my first project on XP and I'm looking to remove the shield and helmet options. There is only one playable character and he won't need a shield nor a helmet. How would I go about doing this?
I'm very new to the software and just want to make the armour options very simple without the need of plugins or extensive coding. Any help would be greatly appreciated!

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body:
Have you tried setting all armors and accessories as shields and helmets?
That way it'd be way easier to simply remove the last 2 options.
Not saying that you can't skip that and just delete the shield and helmet sections, but that would mean you need to use a small script. Otherwise, you'd see 2 empty slots that make no sense there.
